This is the full main primary report, not an abstract or preregistration; it begins after the end of an unrelated report. Supplementary Materials are referenced but not included. No PDF path was supplied.
Only assigned unfinished fields are populated; other fields are placeholders.
The description fits proportion borrowed (F=70.50, p<0.001), rate of accumulated debt (Mann-Whitney z=5.46, p<0.001), or scarcity × borrowing performance interaction (F=12.81, p<0.001, h2p=0.10), as well as a described poor-group performance contrast. A request for a test statistic does not distinguish F from z, and requested eta/d cannot uniquely establish correspondence.
